title: Rav Nitai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Bava Batra 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.111a.8): he intended to rule in accordance with Rabbi Zecharyah ben HaKatzav. Shmuel told him, “Zecharyah’s view is set aside.”[^1]

notes.text: Shmuel rejects Nitai’s intended ruling. The Gemara [later states explicitly](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.111a.10) that Rav and Shmuel both ruled against Rabbi Zecharyah’s position. [Heilprin’s Nitai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2718&lang=en) cites this folio and calls Nitai a student of Shmuel.
